content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe offer integrated platforms for course sales, but they come with severe limitations. Teachable provides an all-in-one solution but requires a Stripe account, which isn't available in many countries. On the other hand, platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, while somewhat flexible, still depend on traditional banking systems that often exclude creators in restricted regions. COREMERCH's infrastructure, specifically the Edge Commerce Stack, empowers creators to build their solutions without relying on third-party platforms, ensuring full ownership and control.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Teachable and Stripe often exclude creators in various countries due to regulatory and financial compliance issues. When these platforms block access, it leaves digital creators in the lurch, unable to monetize their work. Conversely, COREMERCH provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure that is specifically designed for regions where other platforms fail. With the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can deploy their digital stores without the fear of being locked out or having their funds frozen.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal often tout their speed and convenience, but the reality is that they can impose high fees and hidden costs. Stripe's fees can accumulate quickly, and PayPal's account freezes can stall cash flow for up to 180 days. COREMERCH leverages NOWPayments for instant crypto transactions, which come with only a 0.5% fee. By utilizing blockchain technology, creators experience not only faster payments but also lower transaction costs, ensuring they keep more of their earnings.
With COREMERCH, you own everything post-deployment.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Traditional platforms like Teachable and Gumroad often retain ownership of your sales data and customer information. This poses risks if the platform decides to suspend your account or change its policies. In contrast, with COREMERCH, creators retain full ownership of their infrastructure post-deployment. The Edge Commerce Stack ensures automated delivery of products and payment processing, eliminating reliance on third-party services that can fail or change at any moment.

However, if you are serious about building a sustainable business without the risk of restriction, the Edge Commerce Stack is the best choice. It offers a comprehensive setup with five products loaded and full testing before handoff, ensuring you can start selling immediately.
